jobs.title: Founding AI/ML Engineer - Immediate joiners only.
jobs.description:
Xuman.Ai is live on both app stores. Real people are using it.

What is Xuman.Ai

Xuman is building a network for on-demand human connection.

There are billions of people with knowledge, skills, and experience that could be valuable to someone else. Making that accessible is a coordination problem.

What you want to do, who’s up for it, and when you’re both available.

Xuman brings those things into one system. You discover the person, book their time, and connect. If they’re available now, that can happen immediately. And you can make your own capabilities available through the same network.

The goal is to make finding and connecting with the right human as easy as finding information.

Think about how much more people could learn, build, and accomplish if that worked at a global scale.

The stage

What's the rarest stage to join a startup?
Building from zero? Everywhere.
Joining after scale? Everywhere too.
The stage in between is where it gets interesting.
The product is built. It's live. People are using it.
Now it's about syncing what they feel with what we build.
Ship. Watch. Learn. Fix. Improve. Repeat.

What you'll own

- The AI that greets, talks and acts for a user inside a live app, on both stores.
- The agent layer: tool calling, orchestration, memory, routing between models, and what happens when a tool fails or a model is slow or wrong.
- Voice and real-time pipelines: speech in, reasoning, speech out, inside a latency budget.
- Safety and content: the checks before an action or a piece of content reaches a person; bios, captions and insights that read as the person, not the model.
- The ML foundation: the signals we capture, the data behind them, evals on every change, cost per conversation known, and the first learned models when the data allows.

How we work

The founder sets what the product does and how it should feel. When you spot a gap, a bug or a better way, you bring it up before you build it. Once it's agreed, the technical approach is all yours. That is how we stay fast without breaking what people already use.

What you bring

- You have built with LLMs and shipped something agentic to real users, not a demo.
- Agents and tool calling in production, including what happens when a tool fails or a model is slow or wrong.
- Multi-step or multi-agent orchestration you designed. LangGraph or equivalent, and the judgement to keep it simple.
- Real machine learning behind you: a model you trained, fine-tuned or evaluated, and you can say what the numbers meant.
- Evals you built yourself, so a change is proven rather than asserted.
- Python in production, and comfort in a TypeScript service. Ours is a NestJS gateway.
- Structured outputs, streaming and function calling as daily tools, across more than one model provider.
- Model cost and latency treated as engineering problems, not surprises.
- You follow the field as it moves, and you have changed something you built because of what shipped last month.
- You already build with Claude, Copilot or ChatGPT every day.

What helps further

- Real-time voice on LiveKit.
- Retrieval done right, and the judgement to know when not to use it.
- Safety and moderation systems in production.
- Recommendation or matching systems in production.
- Data pipelines at real volume.

What you get

- Work that is yours end to end, not tickets off someone else's board.
- Your work in real hands the same week, on a product that is live today.
- Pay that grows with every milestone we hit.
- Growth that is claimed, not handed out. More opens as you carry more.
- You're joining before the growth. What you build now is the foundation, and inside the company it will always be known as yours.

How to be a Xuman

Experience the product first. It costs you a few minutes, nothing else.

Then pick your path.

Apply here,
and wait for my message to book a time.

Or come find me in the app.
Create your Xuman.Ai profile through
https://xuman.ai/vishal.chamaria
Put up one thing you know, do, or have a strong POV on, so people can book you. Then text me your profile link in the app, or book a time with me.

Before you book a time, two things, so I know who I'm talking to:
• Get your blue tick. It tells me you're real.
• Fill in your details under Settings → Personal. It tells me who you are.
Then book a time with me, whenever works.

Come as a builder, not a candidate.

Social Networking Platforms

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Kadence Talent are working with an exciting startup who are building the foundational intelligence layer that teaches frontier AI systems how to truly understand, reason through, and act upon the complex operational reality of the modern enterprise. This is an opportunity to join a growing organization, and help solve high-stakes challenges where intelligent automation meets large-scale business logic.

Core Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery:
Take full accountability for total project lifecycles, steering initiatives from initial discovery through semantic modeling, coding, performance tuning, and production release without shifting tasks between teams.
Application Engineering:
Architect and deploy advanced decision-making systems utilizing enterprise ontologies, deterministic rules, graph analytics, optimization models, and predictive algorithms.
Upstream Contributions:
Resolve platform limitations by authoring missing utilities, examining codebase internals, framing analytical hypotheses, and submitting code alterations back to core repositories.
Roadmap Direction:
Translate empirical deployment signals, usage patterns, and operational bottlenecks into structured, actionable feedback for product development.
Technical Discovery:
Lead hands-on customer sessions, architectural demonstrations, and feasibility proofs to objectively determine solution viability.
Documentation Standards:
Maintain synchronized repository documentation concurrently with development work and convert bespoke implementations into scalable internal reference guides.
Engineering Discipline:
Uphold rigorous technical standards by avoiding unvetted configuration workarounds, undocumented environment drift, or hasty service reboots without root-cause analysis.

Qualifications

Professional Background:
Extensive history developing and releasing production-grade software applications, featuring direct engagement within client or partner settings.
Project Lifecycle Mastery:
Demonstrated capability to drive complex initiatives independently from vague initial parameters to stable live execution.
Technical Proficiency:
Advanced command of SQL and Python, accompanied by familiarity with cloud data architectures and declarative or logic-oriented programming languages.
Systems Analysis:
Proven aptitude for inspecting unfamiliar codebases, analyzing execution stack traces, and troubleshooting foreign technical environments.
Stakeholder Engagement:
Exceptional communication capabilities required to converse authoritatively with both executive business leaders and senior technical staff.
Autonomous Execution:
High resilience and effectiveness when operating within unstructured, fast-paced environments characterized by considerable enterprise friction.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior success developing analytical, operational, or reasoning systems that achieved sustained, long-term production utilization.
Academic or practical background in optimization frameworks, constraint logic programming, rule-based engines, graph theory, or structured machine learning.
Functional expertise spanning semantic data modeling, pipeline architecture, and enterprise compliance governance.
Established history of contributing foundational features, internal tooling, or generalized abstractions to shared codebases.
Background working across enterprise software, artificial intelligence, or specialized data analytics platforms.

Show more

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer - MLOps

Hybrid - NYC

We are partnering with a fast-growing healthcare AI startup that recently raised $55M in Series B funding
and is scaling AI agents already reviewing real medical claims.
Their mission? Reduce waste in healthcare spending through smarter, more transparent claims operations, and help make care more affordable.

They’re hiring an MLOps Engineer
to own the infrastructure, evaluation, and monitoring that keep these systems reliable as their customer base grows. You’ll report directly to the Head of AI and collaborate with AI engineers, and clinical experts, with meaningful ownership over how the team builds, ships, and measures production AI.

What you’ll own:

Operate production LLM workloads using Temporal or Airflow and Kubernetes, managing retries, timeouts, rate limits, and provider fallbacks.
Build agent evaluation covering quality, throughput, and cost, with release gates that catch regressions before deployment.
Develop experiment tracking, production monitoring, and versioned pipelines for models, prompts, and agent configurations.
Develop and fine-tune ML models and LLMs while improving inference performance and cost.

What they’re looking for:

Around 4+ years of experience
, including 2–3 years in dedicated MLOps work
.
Strong Python and hands-on experience operating LLM workloads in production.
Experience owning evaluation for production AI agents.
Practical model development, training, and fine-tuning experience.
Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar tracking and observability tools.

Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, CI/CD, or healthcare systems would be a plus.
This is a chance to take substantial ownership at a funded startup, work closely with AI leadership, and build systems with a clear real-world purpose.

Applicants must have current U.S. work authorization; visa sponsorship is unavailable.

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Software Development and Technology, Information and Media

jobs.title: Research Scientist - AI Safety & Alignment
jobs.description:
Kadence is hiring for a Research Scientist to join a well-funded, independent AI research organization working on some of the most important unanswered questions around the safety and reliability of increasingly capable AI systems.

Location: SF Bay or Remote
Compensation: $200k - $900k depending on experience and location

Company
Well-funded independent research organization focused on making advanced AI systems safer and more reliable.
Combines theoretical research with practical experiments on current frontier models.
Developing AI-assisted research workflows that can generate, test and verify new ideas faster.
Uses leading proprietary and open-weight models rather than building a foundation model from scratch.
Building internal tooling around automated experimentation, model evaluation and proof verification.
Offers serious compute, ambitious research problems and greater independence than a commercial AI lab.

Role
Own original research into AI alignment, oversight, learning or model behaviour.
Turn broad safety problems into precise theoretical or empirical projects.
Run experiments using frontier models, targeted post-training and reinforcement learning.
Develop proofs, evaluations or techniques for understanding when alignment methods may fail.
Use AI agents and automated research tools to accelerate experiments and mathematical work.
Best suited to an independent researcher with strong ML, mathematics or theoretical computer-science depth.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Artificial Intelligence and Research Services
